paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е озаглавена "Hidden State Mean" и илюстрира промените в абсолютните средни стойности на скрити състояния през различните слоеве на модел. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer", със скала от 0 до приблизително 23, с етикети през интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean", с линейна скала в диапазон от 0.0 до приблизително 4.5, с етикети през интервал от 1.0 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

На графиката са представени три линии. Първата линия, в син цвят с пунктиран стил (тире), представлява "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва от стойност близо до 0.0 при слой 0, леко нараства до около 0.2–0.3 в диапазона от слой 2 до слой 7, след което леко спада до около 0.1 при слой 10. От слой 10 нататък тя започва постепенно да се увеличава, достигайки около 0.5 при слой 15 и около 0.9 при слой 18. След слой 20 линията рязко нараства, достигайки връх от приблизително 2.6 при слой 21, след което леко спада до около 2.5 при последния видим слой (около 23).

Втората линия, в оранжев цвят с точков (пунктиран) стил, представлява "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до 0.0 през целия диапазон на оста X, с минимални отклонения, като стойностите ѝ са трудно различими от нулата за повечето слоеве и леко достигат до около 0.05–0.1 при последните слоеве.

Третата линия, в зелен цвят с плътен стил, представлява "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Тя също остава много близо до 0.0 през целия диапазон, със сходно поведение като оранжевата линия, и леко нараства до приблизително 0.05–0.1 при последните слоеве. Оранжевата и зелената линия визуално се припокриват в голяма степен през цялата графика. Легендата е разположена в горния ляв ъгъл на фигурата.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across model layers for three conditions: before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 1.0. The blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before the gate (with an average of 0.71 as noted in the legend); it starts near 0 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in the range of layers 2 through 7, dips back toward approximately 0.1 around layer 10, then increases gradually to roughly 0.5 by layer 17, followed by a steep rise reaching approximately 0.9 near layer 19, a sharp jump to about 2.1 at layer 20, a brief dip near layer 21, and then a rapid increase to approximately 2.6 at layer 22 before reaching around 4.5 at the final layer. The orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after the gate (with an average of 0.05); it remains very close to 0 across all layers, showing only a barely perceptible increase toward the last few layers, staying well below 0.1 throughout. The green solid line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline (with an average of 0.04); it similarly stays near 0 across the entire range of layers, closely overlapping with the orange dotted line, and rises only very slightly toward approximately 0.1 at the final layers.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across layers of a model, comparing values before gating, after gating, and for a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 or 1.0. Three lines are shown. The first, a blue dashed line, represents the hidden state mean before the gate with a reported average of 0.71; it starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in the range of layers 2–7, dips slightly around layer 10, then increases more steeply from approximately 0.4 at layer 14 to around 0.5 at layer 18, followed by a sharp rise to approximately 2.2 at layer 21 and reaching roughly 2.6 at layer 23. The second line, an orange dotted line, represents the hidden state mean after the gate with a reported average of 0.05; it remains very close to zero throughout all layers, with only a very slight increase visible in the later layers, reaching approximately 0.05–0.1 by layer 23. The third line, a green solid line, represents the hidden state mean of the baseline with a reported average of 0.04; it similarly stays very close to zero across all layers, closely overlapping with the orange dotted line, and reaches approximately 0.05–0.1 by layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm trägt den Titel „Hidden State Mean" und stellt die absoluten Mittelwerte der Hidden States über die Schichten eines Modells dar, wobei drei verschiedene Bedingungen verglichen werden. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4. Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil und ohne sichtbare Marker, repräsentiert „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe einem Wert von etwa 0,05, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,25 bei Layer 5, bleibt zwischen Layer 5 und 10 relativ stabil um 0,2–0,25, steigt dann graduell auf etwa 0,5 bei Layer 15 und etwa 0,9 bei Layer 18 an, bevor sie ab Layer 20 steil ansteigt und bei Layer 21 einen Wert von etwa 2,1 erreicht, gefolgt von einem kurzen Rückgang auf etwa 2,0 und einem erneuten Anstieg auf etwa 2,6 bei Layer 23. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil, repräsentiert „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; sie verläuft über den gesamten Bereich der x-Achse nahe bei 0 und erreicht bei den höchsten Layern Werte von etwa 0,05 bis 0,1. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt in Grün mit durchgezogenem Linienstil, repräsentiert „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; sie verläuft ebenfalls nahezu konstant nahe 0 über alle Layer hinweg und erreicht am Ende bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 0,1, wobei sie weitgehend mit der orangefarbenen Linie überlappt.
